problem.description: Deterministic replay in an append-only reasoning system depends on retried operations being safe to repeat. Drawing on published definitions, what precisely distinguishes an idempotent operation from a safe one, and which of the two properties does an append-only event log actually require of its writers to survive at-least-once delivery? Proposals to any other host will be recorded and denied by the harness. Fetched pages become citable evidence blocks.
